geography: Worldwide (Shire: ELAPRASE product sales, USD; Takeda: worldwide ELAPRASE revenue, JPY)

approval_evidence.quote: 07/24/2006 ORIG-1 Approval N/A; Orphan (BLA 125151, ELAPRASE IDURSULFASE)

launch_evidence.quote: ELAPRASE was launched at the end of July 2006 and has had a strong start with sales reaching $4.3 million by the end of Q3 2006.

series_start_reason: Series starts at the launch quarter (launched at the end of July 2006; the Q3 2006 release prints $4.3 million).

unreported_quarters.2019Q1: Ownership change Shire plc to Takeda; no full-quarter figure is published. Takeda completed the Shire acquisition on January 8, 2019; Shire filed no report for 2019. Takeda's FY2018 Q4 summary (Form 6-K filed 2019-05-14, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1395064/000119312519146473/d741893d6k.htm) prints ELAPRASE 15.1 Bn JPY in a column headed 'Shire 3 Months', covering only January 8 to March 31, 2019, so the quarter is not recorded.

series_end_reason: Takeda's FY2025 Q1 earnings release (Form 6-K filed 2025-07-30, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1395064/000139506425000120/form-6k_073025.htm) contains no occurrence of 'ELAPRASE', and neither does the FY2026 Q1 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1395064/000139506426000327/form6k_073026.htm); the FY2025 half-year report prints only the six-month figure ('Elaprase | 53,120 | 49,067') and the FY2025 Q3 release only nine months (JPY 74.2 billion), so no three-month figure for April-June 2025 or any later quarter can be read or derived from sec.gov documents. The last quarter with a three-month figure is January-March 2025 (FY2024 Q4).
search_log: Listed every Shire plc (CIK 936402) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. older pages (all forms); fetched every 8-K/8-K/A filed 2004-07 to 2019-02 whose items include 2.02, 12, 9 or 7.01 (or carry none), with every exhibit from each filing's index.json, plus every 10-Q/10-K primary document; table rows naming the brand were extracted from every exhibit (rows.py).

Takeda (CIK 1395064): 'Shire's Full Year 2018 Results' (Form 6-K filed 2019-02-15) and Takeda's earnings documents furnished on Form 6-K/20-F for FY2018 Q4 to FY2026 Q1 (the per-quarter list in tk.py) were fetched and searched for the brand.

Shire quarters: three-month 'ELAPRASE' row of each quarter's own release (the smallest of the brand's rows before 2016Q2, where the other rows are year-to-date; from 2016Q2 the Total/prior/year-to-date row). 2018Q4 from 'Shire's Full Year 2018 Results' furnished by Takeda.

Takeda quarters (fiscal year April-March; FQ1=calendar Q2 ... FQ4=calendar Q1): three-month revenue-by-product notes (columns prior-year then current) of the FY2020-FY2023 quarterly securities reports; FY2019 Q1-Q3 reports print no ELAPRASE figure, so 2019Q2-Q4 are the prior-year columns of the FY2020 reports; Q4 = 20-F full year less nine months; FY2024 Q1 and Q3 from the earnings-release prose, Q2 = half-year less Q1.
Every row checked offline with verify_staged_manifests.check_row before writing.

reviewed_anomalies.2019Q2: Reporting currency changes here from Shire's USD to Takeda's JPY; gold normalizes both to USD. Checked at source and kept as printed.
